name: Arcade Mod Reloaded
tagline: Working arcade cabinets in Minecraft: insert coins, play Pellet Muncher, Alien Barrage, Girder Climber, Paddle Rally, Tetrominoes and Snake, win tickets and trade them at the prize counter.

source.upstream_license: GPL-3.0 (LICENSE; mods.toml said All Rights Reserved, the Forge MDK default)

built.builder: AWS EC2 i-07436d854aba1942b (c6i.xlarge, Amazon Linux 2023, Corretto 17, Gradle 8.8 official zip; terminated after the build)

source.modified: every ripped or unclear texture and sound replaced with original SIGF assets; game names changed (library/arcademod/assets/PROVENANCE.md)

notes: You need Minecraft: Java Edition. The app makes its own Prism instance "sigf-arcademod" (Minecraft 1.20.1, Forge 47.1.0, Java 17).
Craft coins, place an arcade machine, right-click it and insert a coin. Scores pay out tickets; spend them at the Prize Counter (plushies, diamonds and more).

SIGF build: the cabinets, sprites, sounds and icon were redrawn and recomposed from scratch and the games renamed (Pellet Muncher, Alien Barrage, Girder Climber, Paddle Rally, Tetrominoes); gameplay is unchanged from the upstream port.
Beta: a fresh port of an old mod (the Girder Climber cabinet says BETA in game). Report bugs on the SIGF fork's issue tracker.
